from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceData(BaseModel):
    """An extracted cash balance line item from a 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the filing belongs to")
    filing_period: str | None = Field(description="The period end date of the filing")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The text label of the line item (e.g. 'Cash at beginning of period')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the balance")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., dollars, thousands)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text anchoring the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_data: list[CashBalanceData]
